messages:
zoe (CS): Solaris bring-up confirmed for Fri 09:00 PT. Need final alignment on quota windows, an embeddings throttle for first hour, and a short smoke. Can infra/sre propose a ramp and brief rollback rules?

frank (SRE): Proposed ramp:
- KV priming 5m
- 5m @15% -> 10m @40% -> 15m @70% -> 30m soak
Autoscale: scale up when cpu_95>0.92 or queue_ms>1700 for 2m; scale down after 10m stable under 60%. Temporary surge: 2.0x for 5m if import at +75m detected. Rollback if error_rate>5% for 8m or p95>3s for 12m.

maya (Infra): Agree with ramp. We'll pin model to solaris-v1.5-quant for 24h and warm the embeddings cache. Also limiting long-context concurrency to 8 for first 120m via proxy. Fallback model staged: solaris-v1.4-fp16.

leo (Solutions): Solaris ops requests: embeddings soft-quota 120 rps for first 60m and a short smoke at 09:25 PT. They'll do a bulk import at +75m and will notify 10m prior. Can we provide a per-route dashboard link?

zoe (CS): @maya please confirm model pin and concurrency cap. @frank paste autoscale snippet to CS-8452. I'll ask Solaris to hold imports until we give green.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-8452 created: Solaris dedicated bring-up orchestration. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8452

frank (SRE): Autoscale snippet (posted to CS-8452):
```
{"scale_up":"cpu_95>0.92 or queue_ms>1700","up_cooldown":"2m","scale_down":"cpu_5<0.6","down_cooldown":"10m","burst":{"factor":2.0,"duration":"5m","window":"first_120m"},"limits":{"min":6,"max":220}}
```

maya (Infra): Model pin + fallback noted in CS-8452. Embeddings cache prewarm scheduled at 08:50 PT. Long-context concurrency cap applied.

leo (Solutions): I'll trigger smoke at 09:25 PT (40 synthetic users mixed chat+embed, ~6m). Will record ops feedback and capture any renewal risk notes.

zoe (CS): EOD checklist: 1) frank paste autoscale + alerts, 2) maya add model pin + prewarm + fallback, 3) leo coordinate smoke + capture feedback, 4) I'll send customer-facing runbook and timeline. Aim to close prep by EOD today. :white_check_mark:
